stem.text: A wave moves along the surface of water.
The diagram shows the variation of displacement $s$ with distance along the wave at time $t = 0$.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement s against distance along the wave, origin marked 0, with a point P labelled on the curve and an arrow above the curve labelled direction of travel.

stem.text: Which graph best shows the variation with time $t$ of the displacement $s$ of the point P on the wave?
